posts.author: cronenbuilder
posts.body:
Hi RPG Maker MZ Family!
I am having a bit of a problem.
In my project I have set it up so my player and follower battle sprites appear on the left side of the screen.
In addition to this slightly unorthodox positioning of the battle sprites, in general my game uses larger than average sprites.
My problem is that the top half of my battle sprite is cut off... (addendum: as I write this  I think to myself, what if I apply a cheap hack and just shrink the size of the battle sprites so it fits on the screen? I think I may do that, though My question still stands) ...and I want to move the position of the sprite(s) down so it fits.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
How are you placing them on the left? It seems curious that you'd have a plugin to move them just to the left and not let you freely reposition them.
Your MZ install directory has a dlc folder with a plugin to do this, SVActorPositionMZ or something like that.

posts.author: cronenbuilder
posts.body:
Hello again.
Yeah the plugin I am using has only the one function of flipping the battle sprites.
I will check out the Actor position stock plugin and see if I cant get that to do the trick.
Thanks you for the info, I'll be sure to post my results with my game preview soon!
